item.title: Kokoro ga Tsunagu Koishirube
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: kate
  • 発売日: 2018-11-30
  • スコア: 6.63/10 (19 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ココロが繋ぐ恋標
  • 英語名: Kokoro ga Tsunagu Koishirube

别名

  • Kokoro Connect me to a Love Sign

あらすじ

Lately Kouki has felt like he was being followed whenever he went. It was as if he was possessed by a spirit. He discussed it with his childhood friend Hinata and she didn’t really take him seriously. He wondered if it really was all his imagination, but then his peaceful days began to change. Even though he was asocial and never dealt much with girls, the energetic class rep Himeno invited him to a purification ceremony and the school’s famous mysterious girl Mashiro also invited him to her club. Suddenly, he was living a new life surrounded by girls.

item.description:

  • 日本語名: 恋はもふもふ！ラブ・ミー・テディ
  • 英語名: Koi wa Mofumofu! Love Me Teddy

别名

  • 恋はモフモフ！ラブ・ミー・テディ

あらすじ

On the last day of a study tour to a rural hot spring town, Shunsuke rashly decided to peep at the women’s bath. However, it was a mysterious bath which had been closed to men since the olden times and he was immediately turned into a teddy bear by some strange power. He still hadn’t yet realized what had happened when his classmate Arisu entered the bath.
